stances_toward.note: Free trade negotiations concluded on 20 May 2026 after four years (goods, services, financial services, digital, investment protection, procurement; the first G7 economy to conclude with all six Gulf states; pending ratification). In the 2026 war the UK sent counter-drone launchers to Bahrain and a Rapid Sentry battery to Kuwait and met Gulf ambassadors on defence equipment. Bond - none: interest, with Gulf doubts about British military weight.

stances_toward.note: First EU-GCC summit (Brussels, 16 Oct 2024: 'strategic partnership for peace and prosperity', a pledge to reach an FTA); talks stalled since 2008, but since the Iran war began (late Feb 2026) Gulf states have asked for a diplomatic upgrade, the Union negotiates bilateral partnership agreements with Qatar and the UAE (Saudi to follow) and an EU-GCC leaders' meeting in Riyadh is planned for the autumn; the UK signed the first bloc-level GCC FTA on 20 May 2026. Gulf security still runs through Washington. Bond - none.
